anonymous_identity_allowed: Use source claim spans plus entity/role, dimension, time and branch scope; do not use the number itself as the identity
required_for_active_support: Source and target original character spans and verified token alignment if later used for masking
Same quantity/claim identity or an explicitly justified transformation between quantities
Consistent dimension/unit, time, branch and logical condition
Target expression or independently reconstructed visible semantic use with a verifiable rule
Source occurrence chosen by referential evidence, not forced global-first numeric occurrence
Distinguish a direct parent from a transitive ancestor
Do not infer correctness of either node solely from the edge
question_proposition_rule: Preserve the entire original proposition with its entity/unit/time/conditional scope. Do not treat every number as a globally persistent current-state value.
candidate_absence_rule: No lexical edge does not establish semantic independence or absence of an event.
review_flags_rule: Surface risk flags are neither semantic labels nor sufficient abstention classifiers. A flag-free edge still requires evidence.
correctness_rule: Edge identity/use, source validity, revision validity and downstream behavior are separate axes; inherit P1_LABEL_SCHEMA_V2 safeguards.
cap_rule: Retain all 15 capped selected traces. Do not complete missing suffixes or label unobserved future dependencies as absent.
counterexample_scope: Handwritten logical controls are not natural-trajectory gold annotations.
intervention_rule: Candidate graphs must not automatically activate the independently prepared five-arm short experiment or define its closure masks.
closure_rule: No closure deletion/preservation guarantee until edge recall, false support and scope handling are independently audited; unsupported is not proven independent.
rate_rule: Report heuristic extraction counts only; no automatic natural correction, reuse, misbinding or causal rate.
